description: This source file defines the SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface to handle placement of grains based on silo roles within the Orleans distributed application framework. It manages placement logic considering silo statuses and roles, providing methods to determine suitable silos for grain activation.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements the IPlacementDirector interface to determine silo placement based on roles for grain activation in Orleans.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the placement director with a membership table manager.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the appropriate silo address for activating a grain based on its role, considering the status and role of available silos.
